presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (2026-09-26, from LAW-0687/0689-0692; docs/AUTHORING.md item 20): the driver is LABEL PLACEMENT at 1:1, not the people floor. With two complete rooms side by side at 1:1 and five (or four) near-maximum participant labels, 2-4 labels have no clear place beside their people even at 16.6 px text and even with people reduced to 45 px (reviewer probe, production/scratch/review-courts-07). Fallbacks tried: wide rooms; narrow rooms with the tables one behind the other; narrow rooms with the tables side by side; the neutral note and key in a band above the scenes; 4 seats in two arrangements; shorter seat labels; sizes 22.5-16.6 px. NOT tried: the stacked arrangement with a right-hand text column that item 20 names (at 1:1 the scenes are side by side, not stacked). The participant count is capped at three (the baseline count); every text stays longer than baseline. Measured: 16:9 20.7 px / people 67.6 px, 1:1 17.1 px / 65.1 px, 9:16 19.8 px / 65.9 px.
